facts.fact: News Moris, citing the Minister of Technology, Communication and Innovation, says the Mobile ID launched on 29 August 2024 and lets people sign documents digitally.
News Moris says public organisations and businesses get a separate application to verify identities against the Mobile ID, with the citizen approving each request.
News Moris says citizens can download the Mobile Wallet Application, a digital wallet holding their identity card, from Google Play and the Apple App Store, using a Maupass account.

facts.fact: News Moris says all holders of a Mauritian identity card are eligible for the Mobile ID, and the cost of the MNIC 3.0 and Mobile ID systems is estimated at Rs 375 million.
News Moris quotes the Minister saying an independent security audit of the Mobile ID has been conducted and will be repeated every three years.
